title.narrative: CSF 08-22, YEAR 3 PAYMENT ENABLE, EMPOWER AND TRANSFORM PROJECT

description.narrative: The overall aim of the project is to reduce poverty, hunger and vulnerability in children, youth, women and their families in three selected districts in Uganda (Wakiso, Mubende and Terego). Nurture Africa will pursue this through health and nutritional support, vocational training, and sustainable livelihoods interventions, focused at household and community level. It is expected that the project will directly benefit 143,830 individuals. These include disabled children, female Most at Risk Youth, teenagers with HIV, teenage mothers, school dropouts and refugees. Nurture Africa employs a direct implementation mode, with its own staff and systems, in collaborative partnership with local government. The project is coherent with the commitment in A Better World to strengthen our interventions in health, education and social protection to reach the ‘furthest behind first’. It is also coherent with Uganda’s National Development Plan (NDPIII) 2020/21-2024/25.
